room_rent.note: No room-rent cap on eligible expenses; room category modifiable (Single Private / Sharing) via Room Type Modification

icu.note: ICU admission always paid up to Base Sum Insured

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; optional co-payment available to reduce premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract: mono-focal lens only for SI up to ₹10L; otherwise no major sub-limits

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible is an optional cost-sharing choice

ped_waiting.note: Modifiable (increase/reduce) via PED Waiting Time Modification optional

cumulative_bonus.note: Unutilized Base SI carries forward, accumulating up to 3/5/10x Base SI based on variant (not a flat NCB %)

restoration.note: First paid claim triggers ReAssure Forever — unlimited reinstatement of Base SI for life of policy

ayush.note: India only; Yoga/Naturopathy need prior approval

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to SI; air ambulance max ₹2,50,000/hospitalization

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments incl. robotic surgery, stem cell, deep brain stimulation

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables via optional Safeguard/Safeguard+ cover

global_cover.note: Cover for treatments in India only

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded; AYUSH/treatment India only; cataract mono-focal lens limit; standard Excl01–18

optional_riders.display: Safeguard/Safeguard+ (consumables), PED Waiting modification, Room Type modification, Annual Aggregate Deductible, Co-payment
